10.description: Ngân hàng 80 câu hỏi trọng tâm gồm Ngôn ngữ (Phát âm, Trọng âm, Ngữ pháp, Từ vựng), Đọc hiểu, Điền từ và Kỹ năng Viết.

tests.title: Đề Ôn Tập Toàn Diện (Trọn bộ 80 câu)
tests.subtitle: Đầy đủ 4 kỹ năng: Language, Reading & Writing

items.prompt: 1. We're hoping _______ tickets to the concert.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'hope + to-infinitive' (hy vọng làm gì) -> chọn 'to get'.

items.prompt: 2. We need to _______ public awareness of the environmental issues.
items.explanation: Collocation cố định: 'raise awareness of something' (nâng cao nhận thức của cộng đồng về vấn đề gì).

items.prompt: 3. Our music teacher has been invited to be a _______ in many music competitions and talent shows.
items.explanation: 'judge' (giám khảo trong cuộc thi âm nhạc). Contestant/competitor là thí sinh; fan là người hâm mộ.

items.prompt: 4. He always helps _______ the housework.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'help (someone) with something' (giúp đỡ việc gì) -> 'helps with the housework'.

items.prompt: 5. We're going to hold a _______ to see who can swim the fastest.
items.explanation: Sau mạo từ 'a' cần một danh từ chỉ sự kiện cuộc thi -> 'competition' (cuộc thi).

items.prompt: 6. We've invited the boss, _______ she may decide not to come.
items.explanation: Liên từ chỉ sự tương phản: 'Chúng tôi đã mời sếp, nhưng có thể cô ấy sẽ quyết định không đến' -> chọn 'but'.

items.prompt: 7. When all members of the family share housework, family _______ become stronger.
items.explanation: Cụm danh từ: 'family bonds' (sự gắn kết gia đình / tình cảm gia đình).

items.prompt: 8. Voluntary / Volunteer work is a great way for _______ to teach children in remote areas.
items.explanation: 'a great way for volunteers to teach...' (là cơ hội tuyệt vời cho các tình nguyện viên giảng dạy trẻ em vùng sâu vùng xa).

items.prompt: 9. Can you tell me who is responsible _______ the finances in your family?
items.explanation: Cấu trúc tính từ đi với giới từ: 'be responsible for something' (chịu trách nhiệm về cái gì).

items.prompt: 10. When you do something good for others, you will find your life _______.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'find something + adj' (thấy cái gì như thế nào). Làm việc tốt giúp cuộc sống có ý nghĩa -> chọn 'meaningful'.

items.prompt: 11. Doing volunteer work, we are more _______ of global problems facing our world.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc tính từ: 'be aware of something' (nhận thức được điều gì).

items.prompt: 12. Environmental pollution is a hot _______ nowadays because it is really complicated and hard to solve.
items.explanation: Thành ngữ: 'a hot potato' (một vấn đề nan giải, nóng bỏng, khó giải quyết).

items.prompt: 13. It’s been raining all day. This weather makes me _______.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'make someone + adj': tính từ chỉ cảm xúc của con người dùng đuôi -ed -> 'makes me depressed' (khiến tôi cảm thấy chán nản/buồn bã).

items.prompt: 14. We _______ in Ha Noi since 2000. We love living here.
items.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'since 2000' (từ năm 2000 đến nay) -> chia thì Hiện tại hoàn thành 'have lived'.

items.prompt:
15. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word:
We always split the housework equally - my mom cooks, my dad cleans the house and I do the washing-up.
items.explanation: 'split the housework' = 'share the housework' (phân chia, sẻ chia công việc nhà).

items.prompt:
16. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word:
Lan’s main responsibility in her home is to keep the house clean.
items.explanation: 'responsibility' (trách nhiệm, bổn phận) đồng nghĩa với 'duty'.

items.prompt: 17. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ có trọng âm 1. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 2: protect /prəˈtekt/, perform /pəˈfɔːm/, respect /rɪˈspekt/.

items.prompt: 18. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ có trọng âm 2. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 1: footprint /ˈfʊt.prɪnt/, artist /ˈɑː.tɪst/, housework /ˈhaʊs.wɜːk/.

items.prompt: 19. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ có trọng âm 2. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 1: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/, service /ˈsɜː.vɪs/, manner /ˈmæn.ər/.

items.prompt: 20. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 3. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 2: organic /ɔːˈɡæn.ɪk/, encourage /ɪnˈkʌr.ɪdʒ/, location /ləʊˈkeɪ.ʃən/.

items.passage:
More than a third of the world's soil is endangered, according to a recent UN report. If we don't slow the decline, all farmable soil could be gone in 60 years. Since soil grows 95% of our food, and sustains human life in other more surprising ways, that is a huge problem. A single gram of healthy soil might contain 100 million bacteria, as well as other microorganisms such as viruses and fungi, living amid decomposing plants and various minerals.

That means soils do not just grow our food, but are the source of nearly all our existing antibiotics, and could be our best hope in the fight against antibiotic-resistant bacteria. Soil is also an ally against climate change: as microorganisms within soil digest dead animals and plants, they lock in their carbon content, holding three times the amount of carbon as does the entire atmosphere. Soils also store water, preventing flood damage: in the UK, damage to buildings, roads and bridges from floods caused by soil degradation costs £233 million every year.

If the soil loses its ability to perform these functions, the human race could be in big trouble. The danger is not that the soil will disappear completely, but that the microorganisms that give it its special properties will be lost. And once this has happened, it may take the soil thousands of years to recover.
(Adapted from ieltsfighter.com)
items.prompt: Question 1. The word "its" in the third paragraph refers to ________.
items.explanation: 'If the soil loses its ability...': 'its' ở đây là sở hữu của danh từ 'soil' (đất đai) phía trước.

SAVE THE PLANET – EAT MORE PLANTS! 🌎
You don’t need to buy an electric car to help the environment — just change your diet! Choosing a (11) _________ can make a huge difference.

🥦 Reduce Greenhouse Gases
Livestock farming (12) _________ about 14.5% of the world’s greenhouse gases. By eating more plant-based foods, we could cut food-related emissions by up to 70% by 2050!

💧 Save Water
Raising animals uses enormous amounts of water — over 15,000 liters for one kilogram of beef! Vegetables need just a few hundred liters.

🌳 Protect Forests & Wildlife
Most farmland (13) _________ for livestock and their feed. If we grow more food for people instead, there will be more land for forests (14) _________ wild animals. Eating less meat is one of the easiest and most powerful ways to protect our planet.

Breaking Boundaries: A Reality Music Show That Transforms Society
Since its debut in June 2024, "Anh Trai Vuot Ngan Chong Gai" (16) _________ Vietnamese audiences, creating an unprecedented bridge between generations and geographic divides.

Originally adapted from MangoTV's show Call Me By Fire, the show brings together 33 distinguished men over the age of 30—renowned stars and influential figures across various fields, including music, dance, film, sports, and photography. Evolving beyond a (17) _________ music competition, the show has become a powerful cultural and social movement. This helps inspiring audiences and (18) _________ the landscape of Vietnam's creative industry.

Through innovative production, the show breathed new life into (19) _________ Vietnamese art forms such as "Chèo" or "Cải lương", making the heritage accessible to diverse audiences. Even in the digital age, the show unites multigenerational families, recreating the shared excitement and discussions like during the Television's Golden Era. It has also brought overseas Vietnamese home, showcasing the show's profound cross-border influence. (20) _________, one particular performance—filled with storytelling and emotion—deeply connected with audiences and helped raise funds for over 100 life-saving heart surgeries.
(Adapted from AAP Releases)
items.prompt: Question 16. Choose the best option to fit blank (16):
items.explanation: 'Since its debut in June 2024' -> thì Hiện tại hoàn thành 'has captivated'.

PLASTIC AND THE ENVIRONMENT
Plastic is a material we use every day. The first plastics were made more than 100 years ago from parts of plants. Plastics are now made from oil, coal and natural gas. We are using up these things so fast that the Earth’s supplies may run out. Because of this, scientists are investigating new ideas for making plastics from plants such as sweet potato, bamboo and flax.

Things made from plastic can be useful for people but bad for the planet. Some plastics can last for a long time without wearing out, and can be difficult to get rid of when they are not needed. They can remain in rubbish dumps called landfill sites for hundreds of years. Landfills can be smelly, ugly, and harmful to our planet.

Recycling is a good way to get rid of unwanted plastics. Recycled waste materials can be used again to make new products. This can be difficult as different types of plastic need to be recycled in different ways. Some kinds of plastics can be melted down and used to make new things such as bags and bottles. Others can be made into fibres (strands of material) for clothing.

Another way to protect the environment is to use canvas bags for shopping rather than plastic ones. A lot of plastic objects can also be reused. Plastic bottles can be refilled many times, rather than throwing them away once they are empty. Unwanted plastic goods such as CDs and toys can be sold or given away to charity shops.
(Adapted from: esolcourses.com)

V.E.O would like to connects people who want to give a helping hand in volunteering for education in the breathtaking mountainous region of Mai Châu. Our focus is on providing informal education and essential skill development for local communities, with special attention to supporting the poor and disadvantaged in remote areas. A core part of our mission involves providing engaging English language classes and vibrant cultural activities for local children, fostering both education and joy.

This program is a great way to get involved in meaningful community service while experiencing authentic travel. International volunteers will gain a deep, personal understanding of Vietnam's rich culture through daily interaction and have opportunities to explore the country's stunning natural landscapes on weekends. You will live and work within the community, sharing meals and stories, for a truly unforgettable cultural exchange.

Time length: One week (available all year round).
Minimum Age: 15+
Price includes: Accommodation, transportation (to/ from the project site and your accommodation), meals featuring local Vietnamese cuisine, beginner Vietnamese language lessons, 24-hour emergency assistance, airport pick-up upon arrival in Hanoi, and a formal participation certificate.
Price excludes: Việt Nam visa cost, mandatory international medical insurance, and international flights to/from Hanoi.
Extras provided: umbrella, sun cream, and T-shirt.

items.passage:
The 3R model, which stands for Reduce – Reuse – Recycle, is considered one of the most effective methods for protecting the environment. In today’s world, pollution and the overuse of natural resources are becoming serious problems. For this reason, many countries have adopted the 3R approach as a solution. Its main purpose is to reduce waste, make better use of products, and transform discarded materials into useful items. This model is not only simple to understand but also practical to apply in daily life.

The first step of the model is Reduce, which means limiting the amount of waste produced. People can do this by buying fewer unnecessary items, choosing products with less packaging, and using energy efficiently. The second step is Reuse. Instead of throwing things away after one use, people can reuse bottles, bags, or clothes, or find new purposes for them. This helps to extend the life of objects. The final step is Recycle, which refers to processing waste materials into new products. Recycling not only saves raw materials but also reduces the need for landfill space.

When combined, these three steps bring many benefits to both society and the environment. Firstly, they help to reduce pollution, making the air, soil, and water cleaner. Secondly, they support the economy by saving costs and creating opportunities in the recycling industry. Furthermore, the 3R model encourages people to think more carefully about their daily choices and take responsibility for protecting nature. In the long term, these actions can also create jobs and improve community well-being.

In summary, the 3R model offers a clear and practical way to move towards sustainable development. Each of its steps—reducing, reusing, and recycling—plays an important role, but they are most effective when practiced together. If individuals, communities, and governments apply this model consistently, the pressure on natural resources will decrease, and future generations will enjoy a cleaner and healthier environment. Therefore, adopting the 3R principles should be seen as a shared duty for everyone.
(Adapted from mdi.vn)

Cải Lương, often translated as “reformed theatre,” is one of the most distinctive musical art forms in Vietnam. It is a type of folk opera that grew in Southern Vietnam during the early 20th century. What makes Cải Lương special is the way it blends different musical and theatrical traditions. It combines southern folk songs, classical Vietnamese music, and tuồng (a Chinese-influenced opera) with spoken drama. [I]

Historically, Cải Lương developed during French colonial times and reached its peak popularity in the 1930s. [II] It quickly attracted the attention of the middle class, who enjoyed its rich melodies and emotional stories. Over time, this musical theatre became not only a form of entertainment but also a cultural symbol that reflects the values and lifestyle of the Vietnamese people. Today, although it faces competition from modern entertainment, Cải Lương still holds a special place in Vietnam’s musical heritage.

A typical Cải Lương performance is full of musical variety. The most famous element is the singing of vọng cổ, a style that means “nostalgia for the past.” This song is usually performed in slow, emotional rhythms that touch the hearts of the listeners. The melody is supported by traditional instruments such as the đàn tranh (16-string zither), đàn bầu (monochord), and guitar. [III] These instruments provide harmony and create a soundscape that makes the performance both powerful and moving. When audiences hear the first notes of vọng cổ, they often respond with strong feelings because the music connects deeply to memory and emotion.

The themes of Cải Lương also add musical richness. There are two main types: ancient and modern. Ancient Cải Lương often tells stories of history, legends, and heroic figures, which are accompanied by solemn and dramatic music. In contrast, modern Cải Lương focuses on daily life, romance, and social problems. The music in these plays is lighter and sometimes more playful, but it can also carry a tragic tone when the story is serious. Whether happy or sad, the rhythm and harmony of the songs help the audience to follow the emotions of the characters. [IV]

Although more than one hundred years have passed since its creation, Cải Lương remains a meaningful part of Vietnam’s musical culture. It continues to be performed on stages in Ho Chi Minh City and other southern provinces, and it is also shown on television programs. For anyone interested in music and culture, watching a Cải Lương play is not only an entertaining experience but also a way to explore Vietnamese history, tradition, and identity through melody, rhythm, and performance.
(Adapted from vietnamdiscovery.com)

c. For these reasons, music is more than entertainment; it is also a powerful tool for emotional balance and mental growth.
d. However, upbeat and energetic songs create a different effect, since they boost motivation and encourage people to stay active.
e. This clear state of mind is useful for studying or working, as soft background music can improve focus and productivity.
options: A. e – a – b – d – c
B. a – b – d – c – e
C. a – b – e – d – c
D. e – d – b – a – c
items.explanation: a (Câu chủ đề: Âm nhạc tác động mạnh đến tâm trí) -> b (Giai điệu nhẹ nhàng giúp thư thái, bình tĩnh) -> e (Tâm trí sáng suốt này giúp ích cho học tập, làm việc) -> d (Ngược lại, nhạc sôi động giúp tăng động lực) -> c (Kết luận: âm nhạc là công cụ cân bằng cảm xúc).

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:

All the workers ____________________

All the workers were being instructed by Alex.
items.explanation: Câu bị động thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn: 'was/were + being + V3/ed'. Đáp án: 'All the workers of the company were being instructed by Alex.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
2. My mother lets me go out with my friends on Sundays.
My mother allows me ____________________
model_answers: My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'let someone + V-bare' = 'allow someone + to-V'. Đáp án: 'My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:

model_answers: The local people are going to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
4. I advised you to prepare your lesson at home.
You had better ____________________
model_answers: You had better prepare your lesson at home.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ: 'advise someone to-V' = 'had better + V-bare'. Đáp án: 'You had better prepare your lesson at home.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:

His parents don’t let ____________________

items.prompt:

Household chores ____________________
model_answers: Household chores are divided equally in our family.
items.explanation: Câu bị động Hiện tại đơn: 'S + am/is/are + V3/ed': 'Household chores are divided equally in our family.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence using the cue in bracket:
7. Jaine last visited her hometown 3 years ago. (has)
Jaine ____________________
model_answers: Jaine has not visited her hometown for 3 years.
Jaine hasn't visited her hometown for 3 years.

items.prompt:

items.prompt:

When Nick and Judy were arguing about the case, Chief Bogo called them.
items.explanation: Hành động đang xảy ra (Quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì hành động khác xen vào (Quá khứ đơn): 'When Chief Bogo called them, Nick and Judy were arguing about the case.'

items.prompt:

items.prompt: 1. We're hoping _______ tickets to the concert.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'hope + to-infinitive' (hy vọng làm gì) -> chọn 'to get'.

items.prompt: 2. We need to _______ public awareness of the environmental issues.
items.explanation: Collocation cố định: 'raise awareness of something' (nâng cao nhận thức của cộng đồng về vấn đề gì).

items.prompt: 3. Our music teacher has been invited to be a _______ in many music competitions and talent shows.
items.explanation: 'judge' (giám khảo trong cuộc thi âm nhạc). Contestant/competitor là thí sinh; fan là người hâm mộ.

items.prompt: 4. He always helps _______ the housework.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'help (someone) with something' (giúp đỡ việc gì) -> 'helps with the housework'.

items.prompt: 5. We're going to hold a _______ to see who can swim the fastest.
items.explanation: Sau mạo từ 'a' cần một danh từ chỉ sự kiện cuộc thi -> 'competition' (cuộc thi).

items.prompt: 6. We've invited the boss, _______ she may decide not to come.
items.explanation: Liên từ chỉ sự tương phản: 'Chúng tôi đã mời sếp, nhưng có thể cô ấy sẽ quyết định không đến' -> chọn 'but'.

items.prompt: 7. When all members of the family share housework, family _______ become stronger.
items.explanation: Cụm danh từ: 'family bonds' (sự gắn kết gia đình / tình cảm gia đình).

items.prompt: 8. Voluntary / Volunteer work is a great way for _______ to teach children in remote areas.
items.explanation: 'a great way for volunteers to teach...' (là cơ hội tuyệt vời cho các tình nguyện viên giảng dạy trẻ em vùng sâu vùng xa).

items.prompt: 9. Can you tell me who is responsible _______ the finances in your family?
items.explanation: Cấu trúc tính từ đi với giới từ: 'be responsible for something' (chịu trách nhiệm về cái gì).

items.prompt: 10. When you do something good for others, you will find your life _______.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'find something + adj' (thấy cái gì như thế nào). Làm việc tốt giúp cuộc sống có ý nghĩa -> chọn 'meaningful'.

items.prompt: 11. Doing volunteer work, we are more _______ of global problems facing our world.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc tính từ: 'be aware of something' (nhận thức được điều gì).

items.prompt: 12. Environmental pollution is a hot _______ nowadays because it is really complicated and hard to solve.
items.explanation: Thành ngữ: 'a hot potato' (một vấn đề nan giải, nóng bỏng, khó giải quyết).

items.prompt: 13. It’s been raining all day. This weather makes me _______.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'make someone + adj': tính từ chỉ cảm xúc của con người dùng đuôi -ed -> 'makes me depressed' (khiến tôi cảm thấy chán nản/buồn bã).

items.prompt: 14. We _______ in Ha Noi since 2000. We love living here.
items.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'since 2000' (từ năm 2000 đến nay) -> chia thì Hiện tại hoàn thành 'have lived'.

items.prompt:

items.explanation: 'split the housework' = 'share the housework' (phân chia, sẻ chia công việc nhà).

items.explanation: 'responsibility' (trách nhiệm, bổn phận) đồng nghĩa với 'duty'.

items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ có trọng âm 1. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 2: protect /prəˈtekt/, perform /pəˈfɔːm/, respect /rɪˈspekt/.

items.prompt: 18. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ có trọng âm 2. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 1: footprint /ˈfʊt.prɪnt/, artist /ˈɑː.tɪst/, housework /ˈhaʊs.wɜːk/.

items.prompt: 19. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ có trọng âm 2. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 1: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/, service /ˈsɜː.vɪs/, manner /ˈmæn.ər/.

items.prompt: 20. Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.explanation: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 3. Các từ còn lại có trọng âm 2: organic /ɔːˈɡæn.ɪk/, encourage /ɪnˈkʌr.ɪdʒ/, location /ləʊˈkeɪ.ʃən/.

items.passage:
More than a third of the world's soil is endangered, according to a recent UN report. If we don't slow the decline, all farmable soil could be gone in 60 years. Since soil grows 95% of our food, and sustains human life in other more surprising ways, that is a huge problem. A single gram of healthy soil might contain 100 million bacteria, as well as other microorganisms such as viruses and fungi, living amid decomposing plants and various minerals.

That means soils do not just grow our food, but are the source of nearly all our existing antibiotics, and could be our best hope in the fight against antibiotic-resistant bacteria. Soil is also an ally against climate change: as microorganisms within soil digest dead animals and plants, they lock in their carbon content, holding three times the amount of carbon as does the entire atmosphere. Soils also store water, preventing flood damage: in the UK, damage to buildings, roads and bridges from floods caused by soil degradation costs £233 million every year.

If the soil loses its ability to perform these functions, the human race could be in big trouble. The danger is not that the soil will disappear completely, but that the microorganisms that give it its special properties will be lost. And once this has happened, it may take the soil thousands of years to recover.
(Adapted from ieltsfighter.com)

PLASTIC AND THE ENVIRONMENT
Plastic is a material we use every day. The first plastics were made more than 100 years ago from parts of plants. Plastics are now made from oil, coal and natural gas. We are using up these things so fast that the Earth’s supplies may run out. Because of this, scientists are investigating new ideas for making plastics from plants such as sweet potato, bamboo and flax.

Things made from plastic can be useful for people but bad for the planet. Some plastics can last for a long time without wearing out, and can be difficult to get rid of when they are not needed. They can remain in rubbish dumps called landfill sites for hundreds of years. Landfills can be smelly, ugly, and harmful to our planet.

Recycling is a good way to get rid of unwanted plastics. Recycled waste materials can be used again to make new products. This can be difficult as different types of plastic need to be recycled in different ways. Some kinds of plastics can be melted down and used to make new things such as bags and bottles. Others can be made into fibres (strands of material) for clothing.

Another way to protect the environment is to use canvas bags for shopping rather than plastic ones. A lot of plastic objects can also be reused. Plastic bottles can be refilled many times, rather than throwing them away once they are empty. Unwanted plastic goods such as CDs and toys can be sold or given away to charity shops.
(Adapted from: esolcourses.com)

V.E.O would like to connects people who want to give a helping hand in volunteering for education in the breathtaking mountainous region of Mai Châu. Our focus is on providing informal education and essential skill development for local communities, with special attention to supporting the poor and disadvantaged in remote areas. International volunteers will gain a deep, personal understanding of Vietnam's rich culture through daily interaction and have opportunities to explore the country's stunning natural landscapes on weekends. You will live and work within the community, sharing meals and stories, for a truly unforgettable cultural exchange.

Program Details:
Time length: One week (available all year round).
Minimum Age: 15+

Price excludes: Việt Nam visa cost, mandatory international medical insurance, and international flights to/from Hanoi.
Extras provided: umbrella, sun cream, and T-shirt.

The 3R model, which stands for Reduce – Reuse – Recycle, is considered one of the most effective methods for protecting the environment. In today’s world, pollution and the overuse of natural resources are becoming serious problems. For this reason, many countries have adopted the 3R approach as a solution. Its main purpose is to reduce waste, make better use of products, and transform discarded materials into useful items. This model is not only simple to understand but also practical to apply in daily life.

The first step of the model is Reduce, which means limiting the amount of waste produced. People can do this by buying fewer unnecessary items, choosing products with less packaging, and using energy efficiently. The second step is Reuse. Instead of throwing things away after one use, people can reuse bottles, bags, or clothes, or find new purposes for them. This helps to extend the life of objects. The final step is Recycle, which refers to processing waste materials into new products. Recycling not only saves raw materials but also reduces the need for landfill space.

When combined, these three steps bring many benefits to both society and the environment. Firstly, they help to reduce pollution, making the air, soil, and water cleaner. Secondly, they support the economy by saving costs and creating opportunities in the recycling industry. Furthermore, the 3R model encourages people to think more carefully about their daily choices and take responsibility for protecting nature. In the long term, these actions can also create jobs and improve community well-being.

In summary, the 3R model offers a clear and practical way to move towards sustainable development. Each of its steps—reducing, reusing, and recycling—plays an important role, but they are most effective when practiced together. If individuals, communities, and governments apply this model consistently, the pressure on natural resources will decrease, and future generations will enjoy a cleaner and healthier environment. Therefore, adopting the 3R principles should be seen as a shared duty for everyone.
(Adapted from mdi.vn)

Cải Lương, often translated as “reformed theatre,” is one of the most distinctive musical art forms in Vietnam. It is a type of folk opera that grew in Southern Vietnam during the early 20th century. What makes Cải Lương special is the way it blends different musical and theatrical traditions. It combines southern folk songs, classical Vietnamese music, and tuồng (a Chinese-influenced opera) with spoken drama. [I]

Historically, Cải Lương developed during French colonial times and reached its peak popularity in the 1930s. [II] It quickly attracted the attention of the middle class, who enjoyed its rich melodies and emotional stories. Over time, this musical theatre became not only a form of entertainment but also a cultural symbol that reflects the values and lifestyle of the Vietnamese people. Today, although it faces competition from modern entertainment, Cải Lương still holds a special place in Vietnam’s musical heritage.

A typical Cải Lương performance is full of musical variety. The most famous element is the singing of vọng cổ, a style that means “nostalgia for the past.” This song is usually performed in slow, emotional rhythms that touch the hearts of the listeners. The melody is supported by traditional instruments such as the đàn tranh (16-string zither), đàn bầu (monochord), and guitar. [III] These instruments provide harmony and create a soundscape that makes the performance both powerful and moving. When audiences hear the first notes of vọng cổ, they often respond with strong feelings because the music connects deeply to memory and emotion.

The themes of Cải Lương also add musical richness. There are two main types: ancient and modern. Ancient Cải Lương often tells stories of history, legends, and heroic figures, which are accompanied by solemn and dramatic music. In contrast, modern Cải Lương focuses on daily life, romance, and social problems. The music in these plays is lighter and sometimes more playful, but it can also carry a tragic tone when the story is serious. Whether happy or sad, the rhythm and harmony of the songs help the audience to follow the emotions of the characters. [IV]

Although more than one hundred years have passed since its creation, Cải Lương remains a meaningful part of Vietnam’s musical culture. It continues to be performed on stages in Ho Chi Minh City and other southern provinces, and it is also shown on television programs. For anyone interested in music and culture, watching a Cải Lương play is not only an entertaining experience but also a way to explore Vietnamese history, tradition, and identity through melody, rhythm, and performance.
(Adapted from vietnamdiscovery.com)

Question 1. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:

b. John: Hey! I’ve been good, thanks. My parents are doing well, and my sister just started college. How about your family?
c. Anna: That’s great to hear! My family is good too — my brother just got a new job, so we’re all excited.
items.explanation: Anna chào hỏi thăm gia đình (a) -> John đáp và hỏi lại (b) -> Anna hào hứng chia sẻ về gia đình mình (c).

items.prompt:
Question 3. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Son: That’s a great idea! I can also make a birthday card for her.
b. Son: Dad, Mom’s birthday is this weekend. Should we do something special for her?
c. Father: Yes, definitely. I was thinking we could cook her favorite meal and buy her a nice gift.
items.explanation: Con trai nhắc ngày sinh nhật mẹ và hỏi ý kiến bố (b) -> Bố gợi ý nấu ăn và tặng quà (c) -> Con trai khen ý tưởng và đề nghị làm thiệp (a).

items.prompt:
Question 4. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Daughter: I agree. It will also give us more time to relax together.
b. Mother: That would be wonderful. It’s important that we all share the chores to keep the house clean.
c. Mother: That’s very responsible of you! You could start by doing the dishes after dinner and helping with the laundry on weekends.
d. Daughter: Mom, I feel like I should help more around the house. What can I do to help?
e. Daughter: That sounds fair. I can also vacuum the living room twice a week.
options: A. d – b – a – e – c
B. d – b – a – c – e
C. a – b – c – d – e
D. d – c – e – b – a
items.explanation: Con gái chủ động đề nghị giúp đỡ việc nhà (d) -> Mẹ gợi ý rửa bát và giặt đồ (c) -> Con đồng ý và nhận thêm hút bụi (e) -> Mẹ vui mừng khen ngợi việc cùng chia sẻ việc nhà (b) -> Con đồng tình rằng sẽ có nhiều thời gian nghỉ ngơi cùng nhau (a).

items.prompt:
Question 5. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful letter:
Hi Emily,
I hope you're doing well. I wanted to share something personal with you because I trust you.
a. Lately, I’ve been feeling a bit sad because my parents are not getting along. They argue a lot, and it’s making things really difficult at home.
b. Thanks for listening. I hope we can meet this weekend, maybe talking in person would help.
c. It’s hard to concentrate at school, and I don’t really feel like talking to anyone about it. I just needed to tell someone, and I thought of you.
d. Have you ever been through something like this? If you have any advice, I’d really appreciate it.
e. I’m not sure what’s going to happen, but I’m scared they might separate.
Take care, Anna
options: A. e – a – c – d – b
B. a – e – c – d – b
C. e – d – a – c – b
D. a – d – c – e – b
items.explanation: Anna tâm sự bố mẹ cãi nhau (a) -> sợ bố mẹ ly hôn (e) -> ảnh hưởng tâm lý và việc học ở trường (c) -> hỏi xin lời khuyên của bạn (d) -> cảm ơn và hẹn gặp (b).

items.prompt:
Question 6. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful paragraph:
a. This not only reduces stress for parents but also teaches children how to work as part of a team.
b. When children take part in tasks like washing dishes, doing laundry, or sweeping the floor, they learn responsibility and important life skills.
c. Although housework may not always be enjoyable, it brings the family closer and builds respect for one another.
d. In a family, it is important that everyone helps with household chores so the home stays clean and organized.
e. Doing chores together can also be a great time for family members to talk, share stories, and strengthen their bond.
options: A. b – d – a – c – e
B. d – e – b – a – c
C. d – b – a – e – c
D. b – a – d – c – e
items.explanation: d (Câu chủ đề: Mọi người cần giúp việc nhà) -> b (Khi trẻ làm việc nhà sẽ học được tính trách nhiệm) -> a (Điều này giảm áp lực cho bố mẹ và dạy kỹ năng làm việc nhóm) -> e (Cùng làm việc nhà giúp gắn kết) -> c (Kết luận: việc nhà đem lại sự gần gũi và tôn trọng lẫn nhau).

items.prompt:
Question 7. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful paragraph:
a. Music strongly influences the human mind because it can shape both our emotions and our thoughts.
b. When people listen to gentle melodies, they often experience a sense of calm, which reduces stress and helps them think more clearly.
c. For these reasons, music is more than entertainment; it is also a powerful tool for emotional balance and mental growth.
d. However, upbeat and energetic songs create a different effect, since they boost motivation and encourage people to stay active.
e. This clear state of mind is useful for studying or working, as soft background music can improve focus and productivity.
options: A. e – a – b – d – c
B. a – b – d – c – e
C. a – b – e – d – c
D. e – d – b – a – c
items.explanation: a (Câu chủ đề: Âm nhạc tác động mạnh đến tâm trí) -> b (Giai điệu nhẹ nhàng giúp thư thái, bình tĩnh) -> e (Tâm trí sáng suốt này giúp ích cho học tập, làm việc) -> d (Ngược lại, nhạc sôi động giúp tăng động lực) -> c (Kết luận: âm nhạc là công cụ cân bằng cảm xúc).

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
1. Alex was instructing all the workers of the company.
All the workers ____________________
model_answers: All the workers of the company were being instructed by Alex.
All the workers were being instructed by Alex.
items.explanation: Câu bị động thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn: 'was/were + being + V3/ed'. Đáp án: 'All the workers of the company were being instructed by Alex.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
2. My mother lets me go out with my friends on Sundays.
My mother allows me ____________________
model_answers: My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'let someone + V-bare' = 'allow someone + to-V'. Đáp án: 'My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
3. The local people have arranged to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.
The local people are going ____________________
model_answers: The local people are going to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.
items.explanation: Diễn đạt kế hoạch đã sắp xếp dùng 'be going to + V': 'The local people are going to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
4. I advised you to prepare your lesson at home.
You had better ____________________
model_answers: You had better prepare your lesson at home.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ: 'advise someone to-V' = 'had better + V-bare'. Đáp án: 'You had better prepare your lesson at home.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
5. His parents don’t allow him to watch such TV shows.
His parents don’t let ____________________
model_answers: His parents don’t let him watch such TV shows.
His parents don't let him watch such TV shows.
items.explanation: 'not allow someone to-V' = 'not let someone + V-bare'. Đáp án: 'His parents don’t let him watch such TV shows.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
6. We divide household chores equally in our family.
Household chores ____________________
model_answers: Household chores are divided equally in our family.
items.explanation: Câu bị động Hiện tại đơn: 'S + am/is/are + V3/ed': 'Household chores are divided equally in our family.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence using the cue in bracket:
7. Jaine last visited her hometown 3 years ago. (has)
Jaine ____________________
model_answers: Jaine has not visited her hometown for 3 years.
Jaine hasn't visited her hometown for 3 years.
items.explanation: 'last + V2 + time + ago' chuyển sang thì Hiện tại hoàn thành dạng phủ định: 'has not (hasn't) visited her hometown for 3 years.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence using infinitive verb:
8. My cousin spent three hours driving to the concert hall.
It took ____________________
model_answers: It took my cousin three hours to drive to the concert hall.
items.explanation: 'spend time V-ing' = 'It takes/took someone + time + to-V'. Đáp án: 'It took my cousin three hours to drive to the concert hall.'

items.prompt:
Combine the two sentences using 'When':
9. Nick and Judy were arguing about the case. Chief Bogo called them. (called)
When ____________________
model_answers: When Chief Bogo called them, Nick and Judy were arguing about the case.
When Nick and Judy were arguing about the case, Chief Bogo called them.
items.explanation: Hành động đang xảy ra (Quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì hành động khác xen vào (Quá khứ đơn): 'When Chief Bogo called them, Nick and Judy were arguing about the case.'

items.prompt:
Change into passive voice:
10. A small company introduced the first e-reader in 1999.
The first ____________________
model_answers: The first e-reader was introduced by a small company in 1999.
items.explanation: Câu bị động Quá khứ đơn: 'was/were + V3/ed + by O': 'The first e-reader was introduced by a small company in 1999.'

tests.title: Đề Ôn Tập Số 1 (Test 1 — Tiếng Anh 11)

items.section_vi: I. NGỮ ÂM & DẠNG RÚT GỌN
items.instruction: Mark the letter A or B to indicate the common pronunciation of the underlined auxiliary verb.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A hoặc B để chỉ cách phát âm thông thường của trợ động từ được gạch chân.
items.prompt: Can you explain how this smart sensor works?
items.explanation: Trong câu hỏi Yes/No thông thường, trợ động từ 'Can' đứng đầu câu và không nhận trọng âm nên được phát âm ở dạng yếu (weak form) là /kən/. Dạng mạnh /kæn/ chỉ dùng trong câu trả lời ngắn (Yes, I can), ở cuối mệnh đề hoặc khi cần nhấn mạnh tương phản.

items.section_vi: I. NGỮ ÂM & DẠNG RÚT GỌN
items.instruction: Mark the letter A or B to indicate the full form of the underlined contraction.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A hoặc B để chỉ dạng đầy đủ của từ viết tắt được gạch chân.
items.prompt: He’s lived in this eco-friendly apartment for three years.
items.explanation: Theo sau là quá khứ phân từ 'lived' cùng trạng từ thời gian 'for three years' (thì Hiện tại hoàn thành: S + have/has + V3/ed). Do đó, 'He’s' ở đây là dạng viết tắt của 'He has'.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn từ có vị trí trọng âm chính khác với ba từ còn lại.
items.prompt: Choose the word with different primary stress position:
items.explanation:
• sensor /ˈsen.sər/ (trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 1)
• impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ, trọng âm âm tiết 1)
• prescribe /prɪˈskraɪb/ (động từ kê đơn, trọng âm âm tiết 2)
• greenhouse /ˈɡriːn.haʊs/ (danh từ ghép, trọng âm âm tiết 1)
→ Đáp án đúng là C. prescribe.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn từ có vị trí trọng âm chính khác với ba từ còn lại.
items.prompt: Choose the word with different primary stress position:
items.explanation:
• pedestrian /pəˈdes.tri.ən/ (trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 2)
• energy /ˈen.ə.dʒi/ (trọng âm âm tiết 1)
• resident /ˈrez.ɪ.dənt/ (trọng âm âm tiết 1)
• modernise /ˈmɒd.ən.aɪz/ (trọng âm âm tiết 1)
→ Đáp án đúng là A. pedestrian.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: Regular physical exercise helps strengthen the immune system and boosts life __________.
items.explanation:
Cụm danh từ cố định (collocation): 'life expectancy' mang nghĩa là 'tuổi thọ kỳ vọng / tuổi thọ trung bình'.
(A. life cycle = vòng đời; C. life insurance = bảo hiểm nhân thọ; D. limitation = giới hạn).

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: Due to different viewpoints on career choices, conflicts often arise between children and their parents in an __________ family.
items.explanation:
Thuật ngữ 'extended family' chỉ gia đình đa thế hệ (ông bà, cha mẹ, con cái cùng sống chung). Về mặt ngữ pháp, mạo từ 'an' đứng trước danh từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'extended'.
(C. nuclear family = gia đình hạt nhân nhưng đi với mạo từ 'a').

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: Scientists are testing the __________ of high-speed maglev trains in reducing traffic congestion.
items.explanation:
Sau mạo từ 'the' và trước giới từ 'of' cần một danh từ. Trong các lựa chọn, 'effect' (hiệu quả / tác động) là danh từ duy nhất phù hợp.
(effective/ineffective là tính từ, effectively là trạng từ).

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: The local government __________ tens of thousands of trees in urban areas since last October.
items.explanation: Dấu hiệu thời gian 'since last October' (kể từ tháng 10 năm ngoái) đòi hỏi thì Hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + V3/ed). Chủ ngữ 'The local government' là danh từ số ít nên dùng 'has planted'.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: You __________ honk your horn near hospitals and schools; it is against the traffic laws.
items.explanation: Mệnh đề sau giải thích 'it is against the traffic laws' (vi phạm luật giao thông) → chỉ sự cấm đoán mang tính pháp lý hoặc quy định nghiêm ngặt. Ta dùng động từ khuyết thiếu 'mustn't' (không được phép làm gì).

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.
items.prompt: This herbal tea __________ wonderful; it contains chamomile and natural honey.
items.explanation: 'Smell' là động từ chỉ tri giác/trạng thái (stative verb) khi mang nghĩa 'có mùi, toả hương'. Khi diễn tả tính chất của sự vật, không dùng ở thì tiếp diễn, mà chia ở thì Hiện tại đơn: 'smells'.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 11 to 15.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để điền vào chỗ trống thích hợp từ 11 đến 15.
items.prompt: Nutritional scientists consistently emphasize the (11) __________ of consuming balanced meals rich in natural vitamins, dietary fiber, and essential minerals.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc 'the + noun + of': cần một danh từ đứng sau 'the' và trước giới từ 'of'. 'importance' (tầm quan trọng) là danh từ phù hợp.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 11 to 15.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để điền vào chỗ trống thích hợp từ 11 đến 15.
items.prompt: In addition, individuals who regularly (12) __________ in moderate physical exercise—such as brisk walking or swimming—tend to maintain superior cardiovascular fitness and lower body fat levels.
items.explanation: Cụm động từ cố định: 'engage in something' (tham gia vào hoạt động gì). 'engage in moderate physical exercise' = tham gia vào các bài tập thể dục vừa phải.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 11 to 15.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để điền vào chỗ trống thích hợp từ 11 đến 15.
items.prompt: (13) __________, achieving longevity requires more than just dietary care and physical movement.
items.explanation: Đoạn 1 nói về dinh dưỡng và vận động. Câu đầu đoạn 2 bổ sung khía cạnh tinh thần với ý tương phản: 'Tuy nhiên, đạt được tuổi thọ đòi hỏi nhiều hơn là chỉ chăm sóc ăn uống và vận động cơ thể'. Do đó liên từ 'However' là chính xác.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 11 to 15.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để điền vào chỗ trống thích hợp từ 11 đến 15.
items.prompt: Therefore, modern health specialists strongly advise people to (14) __________ their daily screen exposure and spend time outdoors to alleviate tension.
items.explanation: Theo ngữ cảnh giảm căng thẳng (alleviate tension), các chuyên gia khuyên mọi người nên 'limit their daily screen exposure' (hạn chế thời gian tiếp xúc với màn hình thiết bị điện tử hàng ngày).

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 11 to 15.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để điền vào chỗ trống thích hợp từ 11 đến 15.
items.prompt: Cultivating positive relationships also helps people overcome anxiety and (15) __________ their mental resilience throughout the aging process.
items.explanation: 'Enhance' có nghĩa là 'nâng cao, củng cố'. 'enhance their mental resilience' = củng cố sức dẻo dai và khả năng phục hồi tinh thần qua quá trình lão hóa.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 16 to 20.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để trả lời các câu hỏi từ 16 đến 20.
items.prompt: Which of the following could be the main idea of the passage?
options: A. Generation gap doesn’t cause a big problem in American families.
B. Different points of view are the main problem between generations in America.
C. The generation gap in the past was different from that in modern time.
D. The areas of differences in the generation gap have changed over the years.
items.explanation: Ý chính của bài đọc: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ 'although more Americans see generational differences, most do not see them as divisive' (hầu hết không xem đó là sự chia rẽ) và các đoạn sau giải thích lý do tại sao sự khác biệt không biến thành xung đột lớn. Do đó đáp án A là bao quát và chính xác nhất.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 16 to 20.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để trả lời các câu hỏi từ 16 đến 20.
items.prompt: The word “prowess” in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to _________.
items.explanation: Từ 'prowess' mang nghĩa là 'kỹ năng điêu luyện, sự thành thạo xuất sắc' (~ exceptional skill/ability). Thế hệ đi trước tự hào về kỹ năng công nghệ (skill in technology) của con cháu.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 16 to 20.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để trả lời các câu hỏi từ 16 đến 20.
items.prompt: What are the two reasons why large differences between generations don’t cause disagreement?
options: A. The generosity of the elder generation and the attitude of the younger generation.
B. The different styles of music and the knowledge of the elder generation.
C. The major aspects of differences between generations and the respect to the elder generation.
D. The pride of the elder generation and the obedience of the younger one
items.explanation: Bài đọc chỉ ra 2 lý do: Thứ nhất, lĩnh vực khác biệt (công nghệ và âm nhạc) ít gay gắt về cảm xúc so với vấn đề chính trị ('The major aspects of differences'); Thứ hai, thế hệ trẻ rất tôn trọng và đánh giá cao thế hệ già về giá trị đạo đức, đạo đức làm việc ('respect to the elder generation').

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 16 to 20.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để trả lời các câu hỏi từ 16 đến 20.
items.prompt: The word “their” in the last paragraph refers to __________.
items.explanation: Trong câu: 'the younger generation tends to regard the older generation as superior to their own generation', đại từ sở hữu 'their' thay thế cho chủ ngữ 'the younger generation'.

items.instruction: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 16 to 20.
items.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn văn sau và chọn A, B, C hoặc D để trả lời các câu hỏi từ 16 đến 20.
items.prompt: According to the passage, which is NOT true?
options: A. The majority of Americans agree generations’ viewpoint to be the major differences.
B. Technology is one of the two biggest areas creating the gap between the old and the young.

items.prompt:
Arrange the following sentences into a meaningful exchange:
a. Nam: Yes, we argued about my career choice. My parents want me to follow in their footsteps, but I prefer graphic design.
b. Lan: Did you have an argument with your parents again? You look quite stressed.
c. Lan: I think you should sit down and calmly explain your passion and future plan to them.
d. Nam: Thank you for the advice, Lan. I’ll give it a try tonight.
items.explanation:
Thứ tự hội thoại tự nhiên:
1. (b) Lan mở lời hỏi thăm: 'Bạn lại cãi nhau với bố mẹ à? Trông bạn căng thẳng thế.'
2. (a) Nam trả lời lý do: 'Ừ, tụi mình cãi nhau về định hướng nghề nghiệp...'
3. (c) Lan đưa ra lời khuyên: 'Mình nghĩ bạn nên ngồi xuống bình tĩnh giải thích...'
4. (d) Nam cảm ơn: 'Cảm ơn lời khuyên nhé, mình sẽ thử vào tối nay.'
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – a – c – d.

items.prompt:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent paragraph:
a. In addition, disagreements frequently arise over how teenagers dress and spend their free time.
b. The generation gap can lead to significant conflicts between parents and children.
c. For instance, while older family members value traditional customs, young people often embrace modern digital trends.
d. To bridge this divide, both generations need to listen actively and respect each other's perspectives.
e. One primary cause of these misunderstandings is the noticeable difference in values and lifestyles.
options: A. b – a – c – e – d
B. b – e – c – a – d
C. e – c – b – a – d
D. b – e – a – c – d
items.explanation:
Cấu trúc đoạn văn chuẩn logic:
• (b) Câu chủ đề (Topic sentence): Khoảng cách thế hệ dẫn đến xung đột lớn.
• (e) Nêu nguyên nhân cốt lõi: Sự khác biệt rõ rệt về giá trị sống và phong cách sống.
• (c) Đưa ví dụ minh họa: Người lớn giữ truyền thống, người trẻ theo xu hướng số.
• (a) Bổ sung ví dụ thứ 2: Cách ăn mặc và sử dụng thời gian rảnh rỗi.
• (d) Câu kết luận / giải pháp: Cần tích cực lắng nghe và tôn trọng nhau.
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – e – c – a – d.

t1_p1.title: Longevity and Daily Health Routines
paragraphs: Living a long and vigorous life is not merely a consequence of fortunate genetics; it is deeply shaped by our daily health routines. Nutritional scientists consistently emphasize the (11) __________ of consuming balanced meals rich in natural vitamins, dietary fiber, and essential minerals. In addition, individuals who regularly (12) __________ in moderate physical exercise—such as brisk walking or swimming—tend to maintain superior cardiovascular fitness and lower body fat levels.

(13) __________, achieving longevity requires more than just dietary care and physical movement. Chronic emotional distress can severely weaken the body’s natural defenses over time. Therefore, modern health specialists strongly advise people to (14) __________ their daily screen exposure and spend time outdoors to alleviate tension. Cultivating positive relationships also helps people overcome anxiety and (15) __________ their mental resilience throughout the aging process.

t1_p2.title: The Modern Generation Gap in America
paragraphs: The generation gap that was so in evidence during the 60s has resurfaced, but it is not the disruptive force that it was during the Vietnam era, a 2009 study suggests. The Pew Research Center study found that 79% of Americans see major differences between younger and older adults in the way they look at the world. In 1969, a Gallup Poll found that a smaller percentage, 74%, perceived major differences.

Today, however, although more Americans see generational differences, most do not see them as divisive. That is partly because of the areas of difference. The top areas of disagreement between young and old, according to the Pew Research Study, are the use of technology and taste in music. Grandparents are likely to have observed these differences in their grandchildren who are tweens, teens, and young adults.
If large differences between the generations exist, why don't they spawn conflict? The answer is twofold.

First, the two largest areas of difference technology and music are less emotionally charged than political issues. The older generation is likely to be proud of the younger generation's prowess in technology rather than to view it as a problem. As for the musical differences, each generation wants its own style of music, and the older generation generally can relate to that desire.

Second, in the other areas of difference, the younger generation tends to regard the older generation as superior to their own generation—clearly a difference from the 1960s with its rallying cry of "Don't trust anyone over thirty." According to the Pew study, all generations regard older Americans as superior in moral values, work ethic and respect for others.

b. Peter: That’s a good point! We'll probably see sensors adjusting traffic lights in real time to avoid congestion.
c. Mai: Do you think our city will become much greener and smarter in the next decade?
d. Mai: I agree, and AI technology will also make public transit run on schedule without delays.
items.explanation:
Diễn tiến đối thoại mạch lạc:
1. (c) Mai mở đầu bằng câu hỏi: 'Bạn có nghĩ thành phố chúng ta sẽ xanh và thông minh hơn trong thập kỷ tới không?'
2. (a) Peter tán thành và dẫn chứng: 'Chắc chắn rồi. Xe buýt điện không người lái và cảm biến thông minh sẽ giảm khí thải.'
3. (d) Mai đồng tình và bổ sung ý AI: 'Mình đồng ý, và công nghệ AI cũng sẽ giúp phương tiện công cộng đúng giờ.'
4. (b) Peter khen ý kiến hay và mở rộng thêm: 'Ý kiến hay đó! Chúng ta cũng sẽ thấy cảm biến điều chỉnh đèn giao thông theo thời gian thực.'
→ Thứ tự đúng: c – a – d – b (Đáp án C).

items.prompt:

a. Furthermore, renewable energy sources such as solar and wind will power most residential buildings and offices.
b. Smart cities are being developed to offer residents a cleaner and more sustainable lifestyle.
c. As a result, urban dwellers will enjoy better living standards with minimal impact on the environment.
d. First of all, advanced technologies are installed to optimize energy use and reduce carbon emissions.
e. For example, intelligent waste management systems can sort recycling automatically and alert collectors when bins are full.
options: A. b – d – e – a – c
B. b – e – d – a – c
C. d – e – b – a – c
D. b – d – a – e – c
items.explanation:
Cấu trúc triển khai đoạn văn:
• (b) Câu mở đoạn: Các thành phố thông minh đang được phát triển để đem lại lối sống xanh bền vững.
• (d) Luận điểm 1: Đầu tiên (First of all), công nghệ tiên tiến được lắp đặt để tối ưu năng lượng.
• (e) Dẫn chứng luận điểm 1: Ví dụ (For example), hệ thống xử lý rác thông minh tự phân loại.
• (a) Luận điểm 2: Hơn nữa (Furthermore), năng lượng tái tạo sẽ cung cấp điện cho nhà ở và văn phòng.
• (c) Câu kết đoạn: Nhờ đó (As a result), cư dân đô thị sẽ có mức sống tốt hơn với tác động tối thiểu lên môi trường.
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – d – e – a – c (Đáp án A).

t2_p1.title: Smart Cities Engineering and Green Metropolises
paragraphs: Urban planners around the world are rethinking urban spaces to construct more livable, energy-efficient environments. A key priority in smart city engineering is the (11) __________ of cutting-edge sensor networks that monitor real-time traffic volume and public lighting. By gathering detailed data, municipal authorities can operate transit systems efficiently and (12) __________ a significant reduction in air pollutants.

(13) __________, high-tech infrastructure alone cannot create an ideal metropolis if social and environmental needs are overlooked. Futuristic cities must incorporate abundant green areas, roof gardens, and designated pedestrian promenades to (14) __________ public well-being. Expanding automated public transit also discourages private automobile usage, helping cities (15) __________ urban carbon footprints and combat the severe effects of climate change.

t2_p2.title: Super Size Me: An Experiment with Fast Food
paragraphs: Super Size Me is a 2004 film by Morgan Spurlock, in which he documents his experiment to eat only McDonald's fast food three times a day, every day, for thirty days.

Spurlock made himself a short list of rules for the experiment, including an obligation to eat all of the three meals he ordered. He also had to 'Super Size', which means accepting a giant portion every time the option was offered to him. He ended up vomiting after the first Super Size meal he finished, after taking nearly twenty minutes to consume it.

After five days Spurlock put on almost 5kg, and he soon found himself feeling depressed, with no energy. The only thing that got rid of his headaches and made him feel better was another McDonald's meal, so his doctors told him he was addicted. More seriously, around day twenty, he started experiencing heart palpitations and one of the doctors detected liver problems. However, in spite of his doctor's advice, Spurlock continued to the end of the month and achieved a total weight gain of 11kg. His body mass index also increased from a healthy 23.2 to an overweight 27.

It took Spurlock fifteen months to recover from his experiment and return to his original weight, but the film also had a wider impact. Just after its showing in 2004, McDonald's phased out the Super Size option and healthier options like salads appeared on the menu.
Unfortunately, McDonald's denied the connection between the film and the changes, but it is interesting to note how closely they coincided with the release of the film.

Arrange the following sentences into a meaningful exchange:
a. Minh: That’s a sensible decision. Cooking at home lets you control sodium and avoid unhealthy fats.
b. An: I’ve decided to cut down on processed foods and prepare my own lunches instead.
c. An: Exactly. I’m already feeling much more energetic throughout the afternoon!
d. Minh: Really? What made you change your eating habits so suddenly?
items.explanation:
Trình tự đàm thoại hợp lý:
1. (d) Minh nhận thấy điều khác lạ và hỏi mở: 'Thật á? Điều gì khiến bạn thay đổi thói quen ăn uống đột ngột thế?'
2. (b) An giải thích: 'Mình đã quyết định giảm đồ ăn chế biến sẵn và tự chuẩn bị bữa trưa.'
3. (a) Minh khen ngợi: 'Đó là quyết định sáng suốt. Tự nấu giúp kiểm soát muối và chất béo xấu.'
4. (c) An hào hứng xác nhận: 'Chính xác. Mình đã cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng hơn suốt buổi chiều!'
→ Thứ tự đúng: d – b – a – c (hoặc nếu mở đầu bằng thông báo của An b thì tiếp nối là d – a – c).

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: SẮP XẾP ĐOẠN VĂN
items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful exchange or text.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để sắp xếp các câu thành đoạn văn hoàn chỉnh.
items.prompt:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent paragraph:
a. In addition, maintaining proper hydration by drinking enough water keeps your digestive system functioning smoothly.
b. Adopting a nutritious and balanced diet is essential for long-term health and well-being.
c. For instance, incorporating fresh vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins provides the body with vital nutrients.
d. In conclusion, combining wholesome food with adequate water intake is key to preventing chronic illnesses.
e. Eating nutrient-rich meals regularly helps strengthen your immune system and boost your energy.
options: A. b – a – e – c – d
B. e – c – b – a – d
C. b – e – c – a – d
D. b – c – e – a – d
items.explanation:
Cấu trúc đoạn văn mạch lạc:
• (b) Câu chủ đề: Chế độ ăn uống dinh dưỡng và cân bằng là thiết yếu cho sức khỏe lâu dài.
• (e) Lợi ích chính: Ăn các bữa giàu dưỡng chất củng cố hệ miễn dịch và gia tăng năng lượng.
• (c) Ví dụ cụ thể (For instance): Bổ sung rau tươi, ngũ cốc nguyên hạt và đạm nạc.
• (a) Ý bổ sung (In addition): Uống đủ nước giúp hệ tiêu hóa hoạt động trơn tru.
• (d) Kết luận (In conclusion): Kết hợp thực phẩm lành mạnh và uống đủ nước là chìa khóa phòng ngừa bệnh mãn tính.
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – e – c – a – d (Đáp án C).

items.instruction: Rewrite the following sentences without changing their meaning, using the cues provided.
items.instruction_vi: Viết lại câu sau sao cho nghĩa không đổi, sử dụng từ gợi ý trong ngoặc.
items.prompt: It is against the school rules for students to bring food into the computer lab. (Using MUSTN’T)
model_answers: Students mustn't bring food into the computer lab.
Students must not bring food into the computer lab.
items.explanation: 'It is against the school rules' (vi phạm nội quy trường học) = 'Students mustn't + V-bare' (Học sinh không được phép mang thức ăn vào phòng máy tính).

items.instruction: Rewrite the following sentences without changing their meaning, using the cues provided.
items.instruction_vi: Viết lại câu sau sao cho nghĩa không đổi, sử dụng từ gợi ý trong ngoặc.
items.prompt: My parents started living in this eco-friendly residential area five years ago. (Using present perfect tense)
model_answers: My parents have lived in this eco-friendly residential area for five years.
My parents have been living in this eco-friendly residential area for five years.
items.explanation: Chuyển từ Quá khứ đơn 'started living... five years ago' sang Hiện tại hoàn thành: 'have lived in... for five years' (hoặc Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn: have been living).

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: TẠO CÂU TỪ TỪ GỢI Ý
items.instruction: Use the cues given to write complete and meaningful sentences. Make any necessary changes.
items.instruction_vi: Dùng các từ gợi ý để viết câu hoàn chỉnh, thêm hoặc biến đổi từ nếu cần.
items.prompt: Although / cycle / be / time-consuming, / ride / a bike / reduce / carbon emissions / and / improve / physical health.
model_answers: Although cycling is time-consuming, riding a bike reduces carbon emissions and improves physical health.
Although to cycle is time-consuming, riding a bike reduces carbon emissions and improves physical health.
items.explanation:
• Mệnh đề nhượng bộ: Danh động từ 'Cycling' làm chủ ngữ số ít → 'is time-consuming'.
• Mệnh đề chính: Danh động từ 'riding a bike' làm chủ ngữ số ít → động từ chia số ít: 'reduces carbon emissions and improves physical health'.

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: TẠO CÂU TỪ TỪ GỢI Ý
items.instruction: Use the cues given to write complete and meaningful sentences. Make any necessary changes.
items.instruction_vi: Dùng các từ gợi ý để viết câu hoàn chỉnh, thêm hoặc biến đổi từ nếu cần.
items.prompt: Regular / physical exercise / and / balanced diet / be / vital / boost / immune system / and / prevent / chronic illnesses.
model_answers: Regular physical exercise and a balanced diet are vital to boost the immune system and prevent chronic illnesses.
Regular physical exercise and a balanced diet are vital to boost our immune system and prevent chronic illnesses.
items.explanation:
• Chủ ngữ gồm 2 thành tố 'Regular physical exercise and a balanced diet' → động từ to be chia là 'are'.
• Cấu trúc: 'be vital to do something' (mang tính sống còn để làm gì) → 'are vital to boost the immune system and prevent chronic illnesses'.

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: TẠO CÂU TỪ TỪ GỢI Ý
items.instruction: Use the cues given to write complete and meaningful sentences. Make any necessary changes.
items.instruction_vi: Dùng các từ gợi ý để viết câu hoàn chỉnh, thêm hoặc biến đổi từ nếu cần.
items.prompt: Install / smart solar panels / which / generate / green electricity / make / modern homes / more / energy-efficient.

Installing smart solar panels which generate green electricity will make modern homes more energy-efficient.
items.explanation:
• Danh động từ 'Installing smart solar panels' làm chủ ngữ.
• Mệnh đề quan hệ: 'which generate green electricity' (tạo ra điện năng sạch).
• Vị ngữ: 'makes modern homes more energy-efficient' (khiến ngôi nhà hiện đại tiết kiệm năng lượng hơn).

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: TẠO CÂU TỪ TỪ GỢI Ý
items.instruction: Use the cues given to write complete and meaningful sentences. Make any necessary changes.
items.instruction_vi: Dùng các từ gợi ý để viết câu hoàn chỉnh, thêm hoặc biến đổi từ nếu cần.
items.prompt: Many / teenagers / believe / generational conflicts / happen / because / parents / fail / understand / modern trends.
model_answers: Many teenagers believe that generational conflicts happen because parents fail to understand modern trends.
Many teenagers believe generational conflicts happen because parents fail to understand modern trends.
items.explanation:
• Mệnh đề chính: 'Many teenagers believe that generational conflicts happen'.
• Mệnh đề chỉ nguyên nhân: 'because parents fail to understand modern trends' (cấu trúc fail to do something: không thể/thất bại trong việc hiểu các xu hướng hiện đại).

t3_p1.title: Secrets of Longevity in the Blue Zones
paragraphs: Living a long and fulfilling life is not merely a matter of genetic luck; it depends heavily on everyday lifestyle choices. Residents of the famous "Blue Zones"—regions where people regularly live past 100—share several common habits. First and foremost, their diets consist primarily of plant-based foods, such as beans, nuts, and fresh vegetables. (11) __________ people in these areas consume red meat, doing so only on special occasions. Regular, natural movement is another vital component. Rather than lifting heavy weights in gyms, they engage (12) __________ physical activities through walking, gardening, and doing manual household chores.

(13) __________, managing chronic stress is indispensable for emotional balance and cardiovascular fitness. Blue Zone dwellers intentionally slow down each day to pray, take naps, or visit their neighbours. Strong social connections also play an instrumental role. They cultivate lifelong bonds, which provides them with a strong sense of belonging and helps (14) __________ their life expectancy. (15) __________, maintaining healthy routines along with loving relationships is the true recipe for enduring vitality.

t3_p2.title: Sleep Duration and Cardiovascular & Cognitive Health
paragraphs: In recent years, the scientific community has paid increasing attention to the profound relationship between sleep duration and physical well-being. Chronic sleep deprivation has ceased to be viewed as a harmless consequence of modern ambition; instead, it is recognized as a direct risk factor for severe cardiovascular diseases, obesity, and impaired immune function. When individuals sleep less than six hours per night on a consistent basis, their bodies release excessive cortisol—a hormone that triggers systemic inflammation and damages arterial walls.

During slow-wave deep sleep, the brain activates the glymphatic system, a specialized cleansing mechanism that clears metabolic waste products accumulated throughout the waking day. Among these toxins is beta-amyloid, a protein strongly associated with cognitive decline. Depriving oneself of restorative rest inhibits this vital detoxification process.

Moreover, inadequate rest significantly interferes with appetite-regulating hormones. It reduces leptin, which signals fullness, while increasing ghrelin, the compound responsible for stimulating hunger. Consequently, sleep-deprived individuals experience intense cravings for foods high in saturated fat and refined sugars. Medical practitioners advocate establishing strict bedtime routines and eliminating screen exposure at least one hour before turning in. Ensuring seven to eight hours of sound rest nightly remains one of the simplest yet most potent strategies for sustaining optimal health.

items.prompt: Can you explain how this smart sensor works?
items.explanation: Trong câu hỏi Yes/No thông thường, trợ động từ 'Can' đứng đầu câu và không nhận trọng âm nên được phát âm ở dạng yếu (weak form) là /kən/. Dạng mạnh /kæn/ chỉ dùng trong câu trả lời ngắn (Yes, I can), ở cuối mệnh đề hoặc khi cần nhấn mạnh tương phản.

items.section_vi: I. NGỮ ÂM & DẠNG RÚT GỌN
items.instruction: Mark the letter A or B to indicate the full form of the underlined contraction.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A hoặc B để chỉ dạng đầy đủ của từ viết tắt được gạch chân.
items.prompt: He’s lived in this eco-friendly apartment for three years.
items.explanation: Theo sau là quá khứ phân từ 'lived' cùng trạng từ thời gian 'for three years' (thì Hiện tại hoàn thành: S + have/has + V3/ed). Do đó, 'He’s' ở đây là dạng viết tắt của 'He has'.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.

items.explanation:
• sensor /ˈsen.sər/ (trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 1)
• impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ, trọng âm âm tiết 1)
• prescribe /prɪˈskraɪb/ (động từ kê đơn, trọng âm âm tiết 2)
• greenhouse /ˈɡriːn.haʊs/ (danh từ ghép, trọng âm âm tiết 1)

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.

items.explanation:
• pedestrian /pəˈdes.tri.ən/ (trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 2)
• energy /ˈen.ə.dʒi/ (trọng âm âm tiết 1)
• resident /ˈrez.ɪ.dənt/ (trọng âm âm tiết 1)
